strings.name: Gianluigi Buffon
strings.summary: Buffon emerged at Parma and became a long-serving Juventus and Italy goalkeeper, known for saves, positioning and leadership. He won the 2006 World Cup and played in Italy and France, remaining at Juventus after its relegation. After retiring in 2023, he became Italy's delegation chief; he resigned in 2026 following another failure to qualify for the World Cup.
